If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase the forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
In late forecast (last 7–14 days), if sentiment is neutral or mixed, adjust forecast to match recent 3-day average of true values.  
If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, forecast should be slightly above the 14-day moving average, not below.  
If sentiment turns negative after a positive streak, reduce forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% per day for next 5 days.  
In mid-forecast (days 10–20), if sentiment is volatile (alternating +/–), use median of last 5 true values as anchor for correction.
